title: Media Storage Incident Response
description: Media storage system incidents affecting production operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on production operations and media access
Implement alternative storage access if available
Contact production team for current shooting status
investigation_steps: Review storage system logs and status
Check storage array health and connectivity
Verify network connectivity to storage systems
resolution_steps: Restart storage services following standard procedures
Implement storage array fixes if needed
Apply storage system patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with storage vendor for complex issues
verification: Verify media asset access and retrieval
Confirm with production staff that system is operational
special_considerations: Never delete media assets as part of incident remediation
Production incidents during live shoots receive P1 priority
Media assets are valuable and must be preserved
Coordinate with production team for minimal disruption
